skill.name: csharp-pro
skill.description: Develop modern C# and .NET solutions using current language features, sound architecture, asynchronous patterns, performance practices, and comprehensive testing.
skill.summary: Create maintainable, tested, and efficient C# applications with modern .NET practices.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive caused by Markdown backticks around a documentation path. The prompt contains no executable code or malicious instructions.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 24 uses Markdown backticks to format a relative documentation path. It does not invoke Ruby, a shell, or any external command.

content.value_statement: Complex .NET projects require consistent architecture, asynchronous design, performance discipline, and reliable tests. This skill provides focused C# guidance and verifiable implementation steps.
actual_capabilities: Designs C# solutions using records, pattern matching, nullable reference types, and other modern language features.
Guides ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, Blazor, and microservice implementations.
Applies SOLID principles, composition, error handling, and enterprise architecture patterns.
Improves asynchronous and concurrent code using async, await, and the Task Parallel Library.
Creates testing and benchmarking strategies with common .NET tools.
limitations: The skill provides guidance and generated code but does not execute or compile projects.
Performance recommendations require measurement in the target environment.
Framework and package compatibility depends on the selected .NET version.
Generated solutions require project-specific testing, security review, and deployment validation.

use_cases.title: Modernize a C# Codebase
use_cases.description: Update older C# patterns with nullable types, records, pattern matching, and clearer error handling.

use_cases.title: Design a .NET Service
use_cases.description: Plan service boundaries, dependency injection, persistence, asynchronous workflows, and testing for an ASP.NET Core application.

use_cases.title: Improve Reliability and Performance
use_cases.description: Review concurrency, allocations, tests, and benchmarks to identify measurable improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a C# Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain [C# feature] for a beginner. Show when to use it, common mistakes, and a small practical example.
prompt_templates.scenario: Learn a modern C# language feature

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Existing Code
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor this C# component for readability and nullable safety. Preserve behavior, explain each change, and propose focused unit tests: [component].

prompt_templates.title: Design an ASP.NET Core Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Design [feature] for ASP.NET Core using [constraints]. Include boundaries, data flow, failure handling, asynchronous behavior, dependencies, and a testing strategy.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Performance and Concurrency
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this .NET workflow for blocking, contention, allocations, and cancellation issues: [workflow]. Propose measurable changes and a BenchmarkDotNet validation plan.

output_examples.input: Review an asynchronous order handler that blocks on a database call.
output: Identifies the blocking call and explains its effect on request throughput.
Proposes asynchronous propagation, cancellation support, and explicit exception handling.
Defines unit tests for success, cancellation, timeout, and dependency failure.

output_examples.input: Plan a migration from mutable data classes to records.
output: Classifies models by identity, mutability, serialization, and inheritance requirements.
Recommends records only where value semantics match domain behavior.
Lists compatibility tests for equality, mapping, serialization, and persistence.

output_examples.input: Create a performance review plan for a high-volume parser.
output_examples.output: A review covering allocation profiles, span usage, benchmark baselines, realistic datasets, regression thresholds, and correctness tests.

best_practices: Provide the target .NET version, framework versions, constraints, and expected behavior.
Request tests and validation criteria with every implementation change.
Measure performance before and after optimization using representative workloads.
anti_patterns: Do not request architecture without explaining domain boundaries, scale, and operational constraints.
Do not accept asynchronous changes that omit cancellation, failure handling, or end-to-end propagation.
Do not apply advanced language features when simpler code communicates intent more clearly.

faq.question: Which C# versions does this skill support?
faq.answer: It can guide modern C# development when you provide the target language and .NET versions.

faq.question: Can it build complete ASP.NET Core services?
faq.answer: It can design and generate service components, but the project still requires compilation, integration testing, and environment validation.

faq.question: Does it support Entity Framework?
faq.answer: Yes. It can advise on models, queries, transactions, migrations, performance, and testing for Entity Framework projects.

faq.question: Can it diagnose .NET performance problems?
faq.answer: It can identify likely issues and propose benchmarks, but reliable conclusions require profiling and measurements from the target environment.

faq.question: Which testing frameworks can it use?
faq.answer: It covers xUnit, NUnit, Moq, FluentAssertions, and related testing patterns.

faq.question: Does it replace a security review?
faq.answer: No. Generated code and architecture require project-specific threat modeling, dependency review, testing, and deployment controls.
